title: Valid Word
summary: A word is valid if it has at least 3 characters, consists only of digits and English letters, contains at least one vowel, and at least one consonant.
statement: A word is valid if it has at least 3 characters, consists only of digits and English letters, contains at least one vowel, and at least one consonant. Vowels are 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', and their uppercase forms. A consonant is any English letter that is not a vowel.
constraints: A valid word has at least three characters and contains only letters or digits.
It must contain at least one vowel letter and at least one consonant letter, ignoring case.
Digits satisfy neither the vowel nor consonant requirement.
reference_solution:
def is_valid_alphanumeric_word(word):
    if len(word)<3 or not word.isalnum():return False
    vowel=any(char.lower() in 'aeiou' for char in word)
    consonant=any(char.isalpha() and char.lower() not in 'aeiou' for char in word)
    return vowel and consonant
